name: Agnes AI
description: Agnes AI's own Flash models, currently priced at zero, behind a standard API.
overview: Agnes AI serves its own models through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at apihub.agnes-ai.com, and the two Flash text models — agnes-2.5-flash and agnes-3.0-flash — have input, cached-input and output all currently priced at zero. Pro models stay metered and the zero pricing is promotional, ending on a date the platform announces. Per-minute request allowances for the default user class are dynamic, so limit values only appear in the console; image generation is billable on separate rates.
free_access: agnes-2.5-flash and agnes-3.0-flash at zero price
notes: Zero pricing is promotional and can end without notice; the China station bills in CNY.
